### The Nature Within
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-7-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 45:24-25
Points:
- Joseph sent his brothers back with abundant provisions, wagons, and new clothes, but warned them not to quarrel on the way.
- Joseph understood fallen human tendencies, recognizing how quickly old rivalries and conflicts can resurface.
- Sudden windfalls, promotions, or unequal gifts easily stir up feelings of superiority, inferiority, and jealousy.
- Giving Benjamin extra silver and garments presented a direct temptation for the brothers to relapse into envy.
- While believers are called to trust and love others, wisdom requires recognizing the reality of human weakness.
